figurative_meaning_bn: নাপিত, যে চুলদাড়ি কেটে পুরুষকে সুন্দর করে
figurative_meaning_en: A barber who trims hair and beard to make men beautiful
example_sentences_in_bangla: গ্রামের নরসুন্দরটি সকালে খুব ব্যস্ত থাকে।
আমার চেনা নরসুন্দরটি চুল কাটতে খুব নিপুণ।
example_sentences_in_english: The village barber is very busy in the morning.
My known barber is very skilled at cutting hair.
note: This is an archaic or literary term for a barber, derived from Sanskrit roots, commonly used in older Bengali literature to refer to the profession poetically.
